name: Planday
description:
Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.

Save time and streamline your daily operations by bringing instant workforce insights directly into your workflow. Instead of switching tabs, you can simply ask for what you need: check who is on shift next Saturday, see Anna’s remaining annual leave balance, or instantly verify James’s working-time compliance before booking his next shift. You can draft, assign, and publish shifts individually, or ask Claude to factor in upcoming events to help you quickly coordinate next week's schedule.

Core Capabilities:

Scheduling: View, create, assign, and publish shifts by department, employee, or date.
Employees: Look up staff groups, roles, and department structures.
Absence: Check live leave balances and review policies
Compliance: Check working-time rules on a schedule

Enterprise-Grade Security & Permissions:
Every action respects your existing Planday user permissions. Managers only access manager-level data, while employees only see their own information. No data is surfaced that would not normally be available to you inside the Planday app.

Securely connect via your standard Planday login with zero configuration required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Planday to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Planday to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://public-mcp-server.prod-westeurope.planday.cloud/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Planday MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planday provides these MCP tools: approve_shift_swap, assign_shift, create_draft_shift, get_working_time_rule, list_absence_accounts, list_absence_policies, list_departments, list_employees, list_shifts, list_working_time_rules, profile, and publish_draft_shifts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Planday?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Planday in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Planday requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Planday is developed by Planday. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
